rows.summary: Design → Spacing offers Page size, A4 · 210 × 297 mm or US Letter · 8.5 × 11 in; the résumé PDF (= the preview), its cover letter and both Word files print on the paper picked, and Backup JSON and JSON Resume keep it through export → import. A résumé that stores none prints on A4 as before.

1-Page Fit writes its preset at once, then prints the résumé with the app's own renderer and, while it runs past one page, steps down a ladder (margins, section/entry gaps, line height, then the base font size a point at a time to 9 pt, all inside the panel's ranges), keeping the first step that fits. When even the tightest is over a page it keeps the tightest and says 'Still N pages at the tightest spacing — shorten the content to fit one page.' Content is never touched; the button reads 'Fitting…' and ignores clicks while it measures, and stops without writing if the résumé is edited, switched or closed meanwhile. Balanced and Spacious are unchanged.

The gate now drives the real components over the fake DOM: every Design section's ↺ (exact writes, template defaults for Academic/Compact/Sidebar/Executive, and keys no ↺ may touch), Balanced and Spacious, the icon size stepper and its limits, Small/Normal/Large and Base with delta keeping, custom font add/remove/unknown, the header icon picker (open, pick, packs, search, close/×/backdrop write nothing, reset) and the starter picker (each starter, blank, ×, the store's createResume). A bug the tests found is fixed: the header icon picker kept the last field's search and tab when opened for another field; it now opens fresh (f16a4dc, fail-first ok). Already covered before: 86-icon-reset-keeps-contact-style, 15-design-defaults, 86-line-height-shown, 69-word-spacing, 86-icon-size-steps, 16-saved-data-typography, 09-contact-icons, starter-templates.unit, 16-saved-data-starter-skills; Cypress 30/13/04 smoke.

issues: R2-149: the fit only checked the résumé id, so a template switch, a typed margin or Reset while it measured was overwritten by a step measured on the old résumé, and a closed panel kept rendering the whole ladder.
R2-149: under StrictMode (main.jsx, dev build) the mounted flag stayed false after the trial unmount, so the button stuck on 'Fitting…' and nothing was written.
